name: ugc-mom-discovery-hook-kids-product
description: A warm, relatable UGC-style vertical video pattern for children's products (toys, kits, games, educational items) aimed at parents — especially moms — on TikTok and Instagram Reels. The creative move is a "POV discovery" hook that positions the parent as the finder of a great product, followed by a rapid three-benefit parade ending in a confident TikTok Shop CTA. Trigger this skill whenever the product is aimed at kids aged 2–12, the brand wants an authentic/organic feel over a polished ad feel,
author: Official
